metrics.resolution_note: No label audit runs on this bank. Confident learning needs an out-of-fold probability per row, and the scanner returns a reading with a tier rather than a probability, so there is nothing to rank a label against. What the bank can resolve does not depend on the model: the smallest accuracy gain that clears a 95 percent test at 80 percent power is 0.316, against the pre-registered floor of 0.030, and confirming a gain at the floor would take about 2,224 rows rather than the 20 in hand.
